_doc: Public platform_operator registry. Keyed by stable NON-SECRET operator_id. Used by services/proof_signing.py to elevate source_class to platform_operator when the calling Bearer key maps to one of these ids (mapping lives in the gitignored data/platform_operators_keys.json). Distinct tier from independent_mediators_registry.json: an entry here is custody-separated from the agent it hosts (the calling key belongs to the platform, not the agent's own self-report) but NOT interest-separated the way a genuinely independent mediator is (the platform has an ongoing commercial relationship with the agent it hosts). Registration is a manual, human-verified trust decision, NOT a caller-supplied flag. Git history of THIS file is the as-of record a verifier can check against registry_snapshot_sha256. Never put an api_key or Bearer token in this file. Added 2026-09-10 per mitre-atlas/atlas-data#20 (arian-gogani) -- named as owed 2026-08-27, shipped same week.
